name: get_node
description: Get token-optimized node/component design data for specific nodes in a Figma file. Automatically prunes AST noise, collapses vector icons, and returns clean Pseudo-JSX/Tree format (saves 85%+ tokens).

file_key.description: Figma file key or complete Figma URL

format.description: Output format: 'jsx' (clean semantic Pseudo-JSX, default), 'tree' (indented text tree), 'json' (pruned JSON), or 'raw' (unmodified raw Figma API response)

include_hidden.description: Whether to include hidden layers (default: false)

node_ids.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs (e.g. '1234:5678') or encoded from URL

simplify.description: Whether to apply token pruning and vector collapsing (default: true)
